title: Bryson Fire replay · Malibu · October 2026
pitch: The forecast saw it coming 6 days before Malibu went dark.
sourceNote: Event dates, times and counts were compiled by the team from public reports (NWS, SCE, City of Malibu, Cal Fire). Grace actions are INFERRED: what PoweruP would have done. No Base customer or real dispatch took part.

demo.title: Ordinary Tuesday · 6 PM
demo.caption: Normal day in Malibu. At the 6 PM peak, the fleet sells SCE peak relief using only energy above each home's protected reserve. That pays for the battery.

demo.title: Oct 9, 2:14 AM · WATCH
demo.caption: NWS first mentions possible Santa Ana winds, six days out. Grace flags the high-risk circuits and checks which batteries report in.

demo.title: Oct 12 · ASK
demo.caption: SCE warns the City that four circuits may be cut from Oct 15. Grace texts residents (simulated) and asks Medical Baseline homes to consent to holding their batteries at 100%.

demo.title: Oct 13–14 · FILL
demo.caption: Fire Weather Watch, then six circuits and a 5 PM Red Flag Warning. Instead of everyone charging at once, Grace staggers charging inside the circuit's spare capacity, Medical Baseline homes first. Export is paused.

demo.title: Oct 15, 4:41 PM · HOLD
demo.caption: The Bryson Fire starts. Central and west Malibu are dark by 5 PM. Every home islands and gets an hours budget, so essential loads outlast the outage instead of running flat overnight.

demo.title: Oct 16, 3 AM · network loss
demo.caption: The network drops. Four batteries go quiet, but each keeps following its local rule. Grace sorts them: not talking, tripped, or broken. By 7 AM, 69,746 SCE customers are out across LA and Ventura.

demo.title: After the winds · HAND OFF
demo.caption: Restoration takes 8+ hours. Grace proposes a staggered recharge for the SCE shutoff officer to approve, so batteries don't create a cold-start surge. Everything it can't cover is listed for a human.
